title: SearchBox#onReset test no longer passes
body:
see https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4156#discussion\_r331552971

It seems like the `reset` event no longer is triggered after migrating to preact X, the tests have been updated, but the event doesn't get called correctly

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/92a21308a272e391de726a47bfaf84e794077697/src/components/SearchBox/**tests**/SearchBox-test.js#L288-L345

We suspected JSDOM initially, but it seems the event does get fired. This means it's enzyme which doesn't trigger the event correctly.
